codeReview.summary: Atlas snapshot reuse and unresolved-image rejection are implemented in the batch renderer, but the feature does not complete valid production image binding. The only production image bridge still emits textureID -1, and no non-test code calls the new bindImageResource API before WinSwiftUIWindowHost submits scenes to the batch presenter, so any real image primitive still downgrades instead of batch-rendering successfully.

issues.description: Every bridged image primitive still gets textureID -1 here, while D3D11BatchRenderer now rejects any image whose texture ID is negative or absent from its bound-image cache. The only binding entry point is D3D11BatchRenderer.bindImageResource (Sources/SwiftWindowsRendererD3D11/D3D11BatchRenderer.swift:134), but no production caller uses it before WinSwiftUIWindowHost renders the runtime scene (Sources/WinSwiftUI/App.swift:532). As a result, the new code proves downgrade-on-unresolved-image, but it does not implement the feature's required valid image resource binding / successful batch image presentation path outside of tests.

summary: Fail: cached atlas replay looks correct, but valid image resource binding is still test-only. Production image primitives are still emitted with textureID -1 and will be rejected by the batch renderer, so the feature does not fully satisfy the promised batch image presentation behavior.
